// Generar reporte de conciliación en español const data = $input.all()[0].json; const stats = data.reconciliation_stats; const matches = data.matches; const discrepancies = data.discrepancies; const analysis = data.discrepancy_analysis; // Generar reporte HTML en español const htmlReport = ` Reporte de Conciliación Bancaria - México

🏦 Reporte de Conciliación Bancaria

Empresa: ${data.company_id}
Cuenta: ${data.bank_account}
Período: ${data.period}
Generado: ${new Date().toLocaleString('es-MX')}
${stats.match_rate}%
Tasa de Conciliación
${stats.matches_found}
Transacciones Conciliadas
${analysis.total_discrepancies}
Discrepancias Encontradas
$${analysis.total_amount.toLocaleString('es-MX')}
Monto en Discrepancias (MXN)

✅ Transacciones Conciliadas (${stats.matches_found})

${matches.map(match => `
Banco: ${match.bank_transaction.description}
Contabilidad: ${match.accounting_record.description}
${match.bank_transaction.date}
$${Math.abs(match.bank_transaction.amount).toLocaleString('es-MX')} MXN
${match.confidence_score}% ${match.match_type === 'exact' ? 'Exacto' : 'Aproximado'}
`).join('')}

⚠️ Discrepancias Identificadas (${analysis.total_discrepancies})

${discrepancies.map(disc => `
${disc.type === 'unmatched_bank_transaction' ? '🏦 Banco' : '📊 Contabilidad'}: ${disc.description}
${disc.date}
Acciones sugeridas:
    ${disc.suggested_actions.map(action => `
  • ${action}
    • `).join('')}
$${Math.abs(disc.amount).toLocaleString('es-MX')} MXN
${disc.risk_level.toUpperCase()}
`).join('')}

📈 Resumen Ejecutivo

Estado General: ${stats.match_rate > 90 ? '🟢 Excelente' : stats.match_rate > 75 ? '🟡 Bueno' : '🔴 Requiere Atención'}

Recomendaciones:

    ${analysis.critical_count > 0 ? '
  • 🚨 CRÍTICO: Revisar inmediatamente las discrepancias fiscales identificadas
    • ' : ''} ${analysis.pending_collections > 0 ? '
  • 💰 Seguimiento a ' + analysis.pending_collections + ' cobranza(s) pendiente(s)
    • ' : ''} ${stats.match_rate < 85 ? '
  • 🔍 Revisar criterios de matching - tasa actual: ' + stats.match_rate + '%
    • ' : ''}
  • 📅 Próxima conciliación recomendada: ${new Date(Date.now() + 7*24*60*60*1000).toLocaleDateString('es-MX')}
Generado por Sistema de Conciliación Bancaria México v1.0
Cumple con regulaciones SAT y CNBV
`; // Generar resumen ejecutivo para respuesta API const executiveSummary = { reconciliation_id: data.reconciliation_id, status: 'completed', match_rate: parseFloat(stats.match_rate), total_processed: stats.total_bank_transactions + stats.total_accounting_records, matches_found: stats.matches_found, discrepancies_count: analysis.total_discrepancies, discrepancies_amount: analysis.total_amount, risk_assessment: analysis.critical_count > 0 ? 'critical' : analysis.high_risk_count > 0 ? 'high' : analysis.medium_risk_count > 0 ? 'medium' : 'low', completion_time: new Date().toISOString(), next_actions: [ analysis.critical_count > 0 ? 'Revisar discrepancias críticas inmediatamente' : null, analysis.pending_collections > 0 ? `Seguimiento a ${analysis.pending_collections} cobranzas pendientes` : null, stats.match_rate < 85 ? 'Revisar y ajustar criterios de conciliación' : null ].filter(Boolean) }; return [{ reconciliation_complete: true, html_report: htmlReport, executive_summary: executiveSummary, detailed_data: { matches: matches, discrepancies: discrepancies, statistics: stats, analysis: analysis }, report_generated_at: new Date().toISOString() }];
